skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the foundational technologies of IoT.
Identify various services and applications within the IoT domain.
Recognize different types of sensors and actuators used in IoT systems.
Collect and process data from sensors in IoT environments.
Design network architectures for IoT systems.
Implement routing protocols suitable for low-energy IoT networks.
Utilize communication protocols in IoT systems.
Program common types of sensors used in IoT applications.
Write code to control actuators in IoT systems.
Develop programs to control devices over a network in IoT systems.
